value.note: je navigue, ils naviguent (to sail; to browse online).
nous naviguons, vous naviguez.
je naviguais; the participle naviguant is attested.
je naviguerai.
que je navigue.

evidence.notes: Fully regular 1st-group -er verb (past participle navigué, present participle naviguant); the diaeresis on the u is not written in these forms.

value.note: Short stem: je nais, tu nais, il naît (attested, with circumflex on the il form).
Intercalated -iss-: nous naissons, vous naissez, ils naissent (attested).
je naissais; the participle naissant is attested.
je naîtrai; conditional je naîtrais (circumflex on the i of the stem).
que je naisse.
Past participle né (attested, agrees with the subject); the attested passé simple il naquit / ils naquirent uses the naqui- stem.

evidence.notes: Irregular 3rd-group -aître verb taking être; the present paradigm, the participle né and the passé simple forms are attested in related_context.

value.note: Impersonal weather verb: il neige (attested).
-ger verb: e before the a of the ending: il neigeait.
il neigera; conditional il neigerait.
qu'il neige.

evidence.notes: Impersonal 1st-group -ger weather verb used only in the il form; source attests il neige.

value.note: -oyer verb: y changes to i before a silent ending: je nettoie, ils nettoient.
nous nettoyons, vous nettoyez; the participle nettoyant shows the same stem.
je nettoyais.
y changes to i in the future stem, attested: je nettoierai.
je nettoierais.
que je nettoie, que nous nettoyions.

evidence.notes: 1st-group -oyer verb; source explicitly attests the future je nettoierai, and the y/i alternation is the standard rule for -oyer verbs.

value.note: -eler verb of the appeler type: l doubles before a silent ending (source attests je nivelle).
Single l before -ons/-ez: nous nivelons.
je nivelais; the participle nivelant is attested.
Doubled l in the future stem: je nivellerai.
je nivellerais.
que je nivelle, que nous nivelions.

evidence.notes: Regular 1st-group -eler verb; source attests je nivelle, and related_concepts flag the future spelling change, hence l-doubling.
